x: Provides methods used for setting the acceleration properties of an Arcade Physics Body.

m.x: Sets the body's horizontal and vertical acceleration. If the vertical acceleration value is not provided, the vertical acceleration is set to the same value as the horizontal acceleration.

p.x: The horizontal acceleration, in pixels per second squared.
